notes.title: Soccer Manager 2025: Out Now on Steam!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45219969/912532b7562f947ba38db02e301d0e27320ecef3.jpg
 Soccer Manager 2025 is OUT NOW on Steam!


After a few years away, we’re very excited to announce that our latest instalment in the Soccer Manager series is OUT NOW on Steam!

Soccer Manager 2025 has so many new & improved features that have been added since we last released a desktop version back in 2021. We heard you all loud & clear when you asked us to come back to Steam, so we’ve brought back all of the following features:

- International Management
- An all new 3D match motion engine
- Create-a-club mode
- A sleeker, more intuitive UI
- Manager customisation
- Fully accurate continental competitions

That’s not everything - there are also hundreds of minor improvements across the board that have made SM25 feel & perform so much better whilst you’re playing it. 
We’re incredibly excited about our return to Steam, so make sure you download the game through the page below.


DOWNLOAD HERE

Play Soccer Manager 2025 NOW by clicking the link below.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3217240/Soccer_Manager_2025/
